summary_en: FY6/27 full-year dividend forecast ¥20.70/share (¥18.70 ordinary + ¥2.00 50th-anniversary special), vs. ¥18.30/share in FY6/26 (¥9.15 interim + ¥9.15 year-end). Interim dividend ¥11.35/share (¥9.35 ordinary + ¥2.00 special) to be decided at Feb 2027 board meeting; year-end ¥9.35/share at Sep 2027 AGM.
title_en: Notice regarding 50th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend and Dividend Forecast for the Fiscal Year Ending June 2027
translation_en_brief: TOW Co., Ltd. announced on 7 August 2026 its dividend policy for the fiscal year ending June 2027, including a special 50th-anniversary commemorative dividend. The company will pay a total annual dividend of ¥20.70 per share, consisting of ¥18.70 in ordinary dividends and ¥2.00 in commemorative dividends. The interim dividend (to be decided at a February 2027 board meeting) will be ¥11.35 per share (¥9.35 ordinary + ¥2.00 special). The year-end dividend (to be decided at the September 2027 AGM) will be ¥9.35 per share (ordinary only). This represents an increase from the FY6/26 full-year dividend of ¥18.30 per share. The special commemoration reflects gratitude to shareholders for their long-standing support as the company marks 50 years since its founding on 6 July 2026.
